release_requirements: source_sha256 contains only exact geobc/elastic_stress_magnitude.py SHA
root_review.passed=true and root_review.source_sha256 is the exact source SHA string

summary_schema.status: completed means bounded scientific diagnostic ended; failed means execution exception
summary_schema.cases: fixed five case keys; scopes.allN and scopes.valid_only
summary_schema.read_receipt: persistent actual attempted/completed counters, including GT cached signed-stress reads; explicit forbidden zeros
summary_schema.cost: costs.cumulative_stage_wall_seconds; cumulative 60s including metadata, IO, H2D, metrics, writes and resume

science.zero_reference: null relative metric; absolute MPa metrics retained; no floor
science.hotspot: ceil(0.01*scope node count), descending abs cached signed S, stable ascending original row tie
science.budget_limited: completed scientific negative with classification budget_limited; no new array reads after exhaustion
science.resume: completed case summaries reused without array reads; partial-case rereads increment persisted counters
